content.text:
This is one axial slice of a T2-weighted fat-suppressed MRI (radiological convention: patient right on image left, anterior at top). It contains a soft-tissue mass.

The left panel is the clean image; the right panel shows numbered marks. Choose the ONE mark that lies inside the tumor, as close to its centre as possible. End your reply with a final line exactly: ANSWER: <mark number>

The image shows a small-field axial slice with a bright, well-defined, homogeneous hyperintense mass in the posterior left part of the body. This is the most conspicuous lesion on the slice, and it is the likely soft-tissue mass.

Mark 7 sits within this bright region, in its right-central portion. Marks 6 and 8 lie in the heterogeneous intermediate-signal tissue and are not within the mass.

ANSWER: 7
